forum.title: New topics are not highlighted in the topic list
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@Andrew Neil ,

By default is selected not to highlight new topics but you can adjust it on your profile:

See more on: [How to set up your profile | Community](https://community.st.com/community-guidelines-160/how-to-set-up-your-profile-118627)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/056387d7-046f-4b90-9c51-30dd1b6eac42.png)
forum.content_text:
Neither in the front page listing, nor in the individual forums.

New threads used to be highlighted in bold on the old forum.
forum.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
I tried it, and it didn’t work at first.

 

Now it looks like the ‘Save Changes’ button only applies to changes on that one page; eg, if you make changes under ‘General’ and then some more changes under ‘Notifications’ and then click ‘Save Changes’ - only the ‘Notifications’ settings will be updated.

Not a great UX.
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil
